speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your current symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the fatigue, flank pain, and fever you mentioned after your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. When did these new symptoms start?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Has the fever reached 38°C (100.4°F) or higher, and is the flank pain located on one side of your back, radiating towards your groin?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of flank pain, fever, and fatigue following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, especially with a history of developing a rash that resolved upon switching antibiotics, is highly suggestive of an ascending urinary tract infection. The initial rash could have been a mild hypersensitivity that resolved, or the antibiotics may have suppressed the initial infection only for the bacteria to ascend to the kidneys. We need to confirm this with imaging and lab work. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_ultrasound.
